title: 第199章 你们三个今天一个都走不了第198章 就这点本事也学人强出头
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
lines: 周元青踉跄上前两步，挡在曹衍砸出的深坑前，抱拳躬身：
“这位大人，我等此行只为寻冯长老下落，无意与镇魔司冲突，刚才之过——”
万钧威压毫无征兆地当头砸落。
周元青来不及反应，被一股无形巨力直贯而下。
他甚至没来得及看清那是什么，只觉一座无形山岳正从他头顶碾下来。
他整个人被直直砸入地面，脚下山石轰然炸开一个丈许方圆的大坑，碎石四溅，尘灰冲天。
周元青躺在坑底，一口鲜血狂喷而出，将道袍前襟染得一片猩红。
陆渊收回手，语气冷淡：“下次来了先道歉，这样我或许会有一分耐心，听你把话说完。”
都动了手了，你还来一句无意冲突。
打不过了知道要道歉了？
搞笑来的？
深坑之中，曹衍挣扎着撑起身子，灰布道袍已被鲜血浸透大半。
他强提一股灵力，从坑中掠出，将周元青从大坑之中扶起。
身躯晃了一晃，尚未站稳，一股令人窒息的锋芒便已扑面而来。
“谁允许你扶他了？”
曹衍下意识上前一步，将周元青往身后一护。
也正因为这一护，他整个人暴露在锋芒之下。
只听嗤啦一声，身上道袍被撕开一道狰狞裂口，背上一片血肉被齐整地削飞，鲜血淋漓，伤可见骨。
曹衍闷哼一声，脚步落地时踉跄了一下，却依旧稳稳挡在周元青身前。
他抬手在虚空中连点数指，周身残存的灵力尽数灌入指尖，在身前凝成一道淡金色的护体符光。
符光闪烁不定，勉强撑起一层薄薄的光幕，将他和周元青笼罩其中。
“我等是来找玄清观冯端长老的，请大人恕罪。”
“今日之过，玄清观定会上报清溪驻所，按律领罚，绝无二言。”
曹衍一口气说完，苍老的声音带着压抑不住的虚弱。
他生怕中间有半分停顿，陆渊又要再次杀来。
连续两记重击，让他这个化境巅峰的玄清观长老也有些招架不住。
后背剧痛如烈火灼烧，又在提醒他眼前之人不可力敌。
更让他心惊的是，从万钧威压到玄煞符，陆渊所施展的手段他一样都看不透。
此人性格霸道，下手果决，若再不出言表明来意，恐怕今天他们三人一个都走不了。
“早点说找冯端不就好了？”陆渊的声音从曹衍身后传来。
什么时候？！
曹衍心头剧震。
他甚至未曾感知到半分灵力波动，陆渊便已从他的正前方无声无息地出现在他身后。
这是什么身法？
移形换影？
不对，即便是移形换影也不可能完全避开他的感知。
他修行近百年，见过无数轻功身法，从没有一种能快到这种地步，像是凭空挪移，连一丝残影都不留。
但他来不及细想了。
几乎是同一瞬间，曹衍残存的灵力尽数灌入指尖，一指点在身侧虚空。
没有符纸朱砂，纯粹以灵力为引，空气中凝成一道泛着淡金光泽的符箓。
content_en:
Zhou Yuanqing staggered forward two steps, blocked the pit created by Cao Yan, cupped his fists and bowed:
"My lord, we are only here to find Elder Feng's whereabouts. We have no intention of conflict with the Demon Suppressor. What we just did -"
Boom——
Wanjun's coercion fell on his head without any warning.
Zhou Yuanqing had no time to react and was struck straight down by an invisible force.
He didn't even have time to see clearly what it was, only to feel an invisible mountain crushing down from above his head.
His whole body was smashed straight into the ground, and a large crater about ten feet in diameter exploded out of the rocks at his feet. The rubble flew everywhere and dust shot into the sky.
Zhou Yuanqing lay at the bottom of the pit, a mouthful of blood spurting out, dyeing the front of the Taoist robe scarlet.
Lu Yuan took back his hand and said in a cold tone: "Apologise first next time, so that I may have some patience and listen to what you have to say."
They've already moved their hands, but you still said something that was unintentional and conflicting.
You know you have to apologize if you can't beat me?
Is it funny?
In the deep pit, Cao Yan struggled to hold himself up, and his gray preacher's robe was mostly soaked in blood.
He forced a burst of spiritual power out of the pit and helped Zhou Yuanqing up from the pit.
His body swayed, but before he could stand still, a suffocating edge hit his face.
"Who allowed you to help him?"
Cao Yan subconsciously took a step forward and pushed Zhou Yuanqing behind him to protect him.
It was precisely because of this protection that his whole body was exposed to the edge.
There was just a scoff, and a ferocious tear was ripped open in the Taoist robe on his body, and a piece of flesh and blood on his back was neatly shaved off. The blood was dripping, and the bones were visible from the injury.
Cao Yan groaned and staggered when he landed, but he still stood firmly in front of Zhou Yuanqing.
He raised his hand and counted his fingers in the void, and all the remaining spiritual energy around him poured into his fingertips, condensing into a light golden protective talisman in front of him.
The talisman light flickered uncertainly, barely holding up a thin light curtain, covering him and Zhou Yuanqing.
"We are here to see Elder Feng Duan of Xuanqing Temple. Please forgive me."
"After today's incident, Xuanqing Guan will definitely report to the Qingxi Station and receive punishment according to the law, without hesitation."
Cao Yan finished speaking in one breath, his old voice filled with irrepressible weakness.
He was afraid that if there was a pause in the middle, Lu Yuan would come to kill him again.
Two consecutive heavy blows made him, an elder of Xuan Qingguan at the peak of his transformation state, unable to resist.
The sharp pain in his back was like burning fire, reminding him that the person in front of him was invincible.
What frightened him even more was that he couldn't see through any of the methods used by Lu Yuan, from the overwhelming pressure to the Xuansha Talisman.
This person has a domineering personality and is decisive in his actions. If he doesn't express his intentions in words, I'm afraid none of the three of them will be able to leave today.
"Wouldn't it be better to tell Feng Duan earlier?" Lu Yuan's voice came from behind Cao Yan.
when? !
Cao Yan was shocked.
Before he even sensed the slightest fluctuation of spiritual power, Lu Yuan silently appeared behind him from directly in front of him.
What kind of movement is this?
Apparition?
No, even disembodiment cannot completely avoid his perception.
He has been practicing for nearly a hundred years and has seen countless Qinggong movements, but none of them have been so fast, as if they were moved out of thin air, leaving not even an afterimage.
But he didn't have time to think about it.
Almost at the same moment, Cao Yan's remaining spiritual power was poured into his fingertips, and he pointed in the void beside him.
There is no cinnabar on the talisman paper, and it is purely guided by spiritual power. A talisman with a light golden luster condenses in the air.
title_en: Chapter 199: None of the three of you can leave today. Chapter 198: Even with this little skill, you can learn to stand out from others.
